topics.title: UNESCO events mark Hrachia Acharian anniversary
topics.text: Events in Paris concluded marking the 150th birth anniversary of Hrachia Acharian and the centenary of Republic Square, organized by UNESCO.

topics.title: Armenian FM at Manama Dialogue
